popup.title: Shipwreck

Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Underwater shipwreck. Player directed here as a part of a side mission for Kenton

popup.title: Easter Egg: Giant Grab
popup.description:
Location: [[State of Leonida|Leonida]]
Enter a dead spot and activate the power box, the same one you use when entering the house. Go to the left room, interact with the paper, and use the last word as the computer password. Access the computer to get your sentence. Then, go to the safe in the house and enter the code “0072” to collect your items. Walk to the back, where you can explore for small health items. Find the dock, keep walking, and you’ll find a pin “0212” you will find a mp5 and $10k
